name: 联系邮箱
description: Candidate contact addresses discovered for a company, several per company

agentPrompts.label: Review candidate addresses for a company
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder, then list the candidate addresses found for the company I name, with each one's role, source link, and confidence grade (high/medium/low), so I can pick which one to use.

agentPrompts.label: Check where an address came from
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder, then show the source URL behind the address I name. An address with no recorded source is a guess and must not be used — the desk should show 未找到邮箱 instead.
